set.t: One printed account, undated; the Cadillac Evening News of 1923 is being checked. Old Jennings Cemetery (south of the village) is graves: look-only. The hermit is not yet identified. The 1910 census of Lake Twp lists only one Swedish-born Larson, Lewis Larson (born 1851) and his wife Matilda; no John or Jens Larson appears in Missaukee Co. in 1900 or 1910. A Jens Larson who died in Lake Twp in 1916 was a Danish-born farmer and does not fit. The 1906 plat shows one L. G. Larson 40 in sec. 24, 3 mi SE of the village and away from the lakes; no proven link to the hermit. Pin stays on the village and Crooked Lake.
